name: spring-dashpot element
definition_zh: 用弹簧及阻尼器表征连接关系的理想化单元。
definition_en: An idealized connection represented by a spring and a damping element.
usage_overview: 用于将车辆悬挂、轨道层间、支座及结构—土体界面等连接或支承等效为刚度与阻尼关系，通过连接两端的相对位移和速度描述弹性传力与耗能作用，以建立各部件之间的动力耦合。

complete_examples.text: In this work, the coupler and draft gear system (C.D.G.) among the car body of the vehicles is modelled as a 3-D spring-dashpot element, which contains linear stiffness and damping coefficients along X -, Y - and Z -direction, respectively.
Both the rail and sleeper are modelled as Bernoulli–Euler beam-column; the rail pad is modelled as a spring-dashpot element, and the railway ballast is modelled as a mass–spring–damper element.
In the finite element method, the filling component between the gap of two adjacent slabs in longitudinal connected slab system is modeled as the spring-dashpot element.

For the spring-dashpot element used in the longitudinal connection type of track, the detail value of stiffness for three directions can be calculated by kLCT 1⁄4 E=a (3) Where kLCT is the stiffness per unit area of connection spring; E is the elastic modulus of filling material, a is the thickness of the corresponding direction.

In this work, the model in 19 can be further extended and improved by combing with the tunnel-soil modelling method presented in,9 where the infinite element boundary of the tunnel can be replaced by the spring-dashpot element using penalty method.
